title: Amenity (official public-amenity listing)
description: One record: one public amenity a traveller looks for on the street, as a city or public body lists it: a public toilet, a drinking fountain or a free public Wi-Fi spot, with its location, opening hours and wheelchair access. Voyager use: travel tips and getting around (where to find a toilet or free Wi-Fi near the itinerary).

name.description: The amenity's name or location as the listing writes it (e.g. "Heckscher Playground", "Bürkliplatz").

amenity_type.description: What the amenity is: a public toilet, a drinking-water fountain, a free public Wi-Fi spot, or other.

description.description: The listing's own remarks as written (e.g. "Attended, closed at night, free of charge").

address.description: Street address or street corner as written.

city.description: City in English. Always paired with `country`.

country.description: Country in English (e.g. "Austria"). Required whenever `city` is set.

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees, only if the listing states coordinates.

lng.description: Longitude in decimal degrees, only if the listing states coordinates.

opening_hours.description: Opening hours as written (days and times).

wheelchair_accessible.description: Stated wheelchair access (true only when the listing says so; false when it says it is not accessible).

operator.description: Who runs it, as written (e.g. "NYC Parks").

phone.description: Phone number. As written on the page (digits, spaces, +, -, (, ), .).

info_url.description: The listing's information page for the amenity, copied verbatim.

source_url.description: The page's own link for this item (official site or detail page), copied verbatim from the page.

as_of.description: The "last updated", "valid from" or publication date the page itself states for this information (YYYY-MM-DD).

items.description: A verbatim quote from the page.

evidence.description: Up to 3 short verbatim quotes from the page that support the most important facts.
